name: gdx
description: Git, but with better DX. The raw power of Git, aligned with human workflows.
author: Type-Delta

scripts.transpile-esm: bunx tsc -p lib/tsconfig.json && bun run scripts/transform-tools.mjs
scripts.check: bun run ts-check && bun run lint && bun run build
scripts.lint: bun run ts-check && eslint src --ext .ts -c eslint.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: bun run ts-check && eslint src --ext .ts -c eslint.config.ts --fix
scripts.build: bun run transpile-esm && bun run build:diagnostics:bin && GDX_BUILD=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty) bun build ./src/index.ts --env='GDX_BUILD*' --outfile=./bin/gdx --compile --bytecode --production --keep-names
scripts.build:release:win32-x64: bun run transpile-esm && bun run build:diagnostics:bin && GDX_BUILD=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty) bun build ./src/index.ts --env='GDX_BUILD*' --outfile=./bin/gdx-win32-x64.exe --compile --bytecode --production --keep-names
scripts.package:node: bun run transpile-esm && GDX_BUILD=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty) bun build ./src/index.ts --env='GDX_BUILD*' --outdir=./dist --target=node --external=keytar --external=cspell-lib --external=@shikijs/cli --external=shiki --external=yaml --external=openai --external=fflate --external=diff --external=@leeoniya/ufuzzy --format=esm --production --keep-names && bun build ./src/workers/generic.worker.ts --outfile=./dist/workers/generic.worker.min.js --target=node --external=@shikijs/cli --format=esm --production --minify --keep-names && bun run build:diagnostics:node
